1980-2134-4050-8240.description:
Cast Bond of Insight by paying {3}{U}.
Grandmother Goby and Swarm Intelligence trigger.
Resolve the Grandmother Goby trigger, countering Bond of Inisght and creating four 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Resolve the Swarm Intelligence trigger, copying Bond of Insight.
Resolve the copy of Bond of Insight, causing each player to mill four cards and then returning the original Bond of Insight and up to one other instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing the four Merfolk tokens, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

997-5254-6774.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
997-5254-6774.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

147-4050-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4050-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
147-4050-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-2158-3249-5457--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-5457--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Selvala triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2113-3249-4314--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2113-3249-4314--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

3800-4213-4687.notablePrerequisites: Iceberg has at least four counters on it.
3800-4213-4687.description:
Activate Hankyu by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Iceberg.
Activate Iceberg as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Iceberg, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1657-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
1657-7804.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it and Captain Kathryn Janeway trigger.
Resolve the Captain Kathryn Janeway trigger, revealing the top card of your library, then putting it back and putting a +1/+1 counter on Murderous Redcap.
Resolve the Murderous Redcap trigger, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-3967-4605-5542-6146.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6146.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ravenloft Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Ravenloft Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6146.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1368-6321-7175-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-6321-7175-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

5231-5508--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the persist creature.
Repeat

413-856-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar, Blasting Station and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7323.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mechanized Ninja Cavalry, adding {C}{C}.
When Mechanized Ninja Cavalry dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Mechanized Ninja Cavalry from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Mechanized Ninja Cavalry enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

339-677-2511-4460.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4871-5220-5946-6797.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You control at least three creatures with different powers.
4871-5220-5946-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

4046-5465-7070.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Outrider en-Kor.
The Outrider en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Outrider en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Repeat.

1651-2638-6751-6756-6850.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2638-6751-6756-6850.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2638-6751-6756-6850.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1339-2122-4029-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-4029-5231.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1020-2510-3689-6518.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact or creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1020-2510-3689-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

56-4556-5256-6255.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-4556-5256-6255.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Blight Mound and Zahur trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-4556-5256-6255.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

1669-4826-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Archelos is untapped.
1669-4826-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Thaumatog's first ability by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

2178-4227-4395.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4227-4395.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

579-3360-4289.notablePrerequisites: Torchling does not have summoning sickness.
579-3360-4289.description:
Activate Torchling's first ability by tapping it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat.

841-4050-4544-5310.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-4050-4544-5310.description:
Play a land card, triggering Dúnedain Rangers and Bloodghast.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing Bloodghast to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodghast, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dúnedain Rangers and Bloodghast trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

1636-1687-4050-4649-4772.notablePrerequisites: Tempting Licid does not have summoning sickness.
1636-1687-4050-4649-4772.description:
Activate Tempting Licid by tapping it and paying {G}, attaching it to Siona.
Siona triggers, creating two Human Soldier creature tokens.
Intruder Alarm triggers twice.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing a Human Soldier creature token, adding {G} each time.
Pay {G} to end Tempting Licid's effect, making it a creture once more.
Resolve both Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2679-2836.notablePrerequisites:
There are no white cards in library.
You have a way to draw a card available.
2679-2836.description:
Activate Sacred Guide for {1}{W}, exiling your library.
Draw a card, winning the game.
